economy.summary: In a 2022 candidate profile during his previous run for this seat, he ran as anti-inflation and said he supported spurring economic recovery after the COVID-19 pandemic.
economy.short: Ran anti-inflation; supported post-pandemic economic recovery (2022 campaign).

guns.summary: In his 2022 run for this seat, said he supports a strong police force paired with unbiased oversight; he was endorsed by Firearm Owners Against Crime, a gun-owner rights group, and did not detail positions on specific firearms legislation.
guns.short: Supports strong police with unbiased oversight; endorsed by gun-rights group.

economy.summary: Voted in June 2025 for House Bill 1549, which would raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage; the bill passed the state House 102-101. He had earlier said in 2022 that he supports raising the state minimum wage.
economy.short: Voted for 2025 bill raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage.

abortion.summary: Voted against legislation that would have set up a statewide referendum on abortion access and said in 2022 that he wants to maintain Pennsylvania's current abortion laws.
abortion.short: Opposed abortion referendum; wants to maintain current state abortion laws.

education.summary: Supported a bill that would expand the free school breakfast and lunch program, according to a 2022 candidate profile.
education.short: Supported bill expanding free school breakfast and lunch program.

guns.summary: Said in 2022 that he supports universal background checks for firearm purchases.
guns.short: Supports universal background checks for firearm purchases.
